text:
maya: Heads-up — proposing a lightweight IA tweak for the left nav: group Observability + Metrics under a new 'Monitoring' parent and introduce a small tertiary flyout for resource-scoped pages so the main tree doesn't get deeper.

devin: Curious — what's the main win? fewer clicks or clearer scoping?

maya: Both. For product pages like Models -> Versions -> Metrics we currently expand 3 levels. Flyout keeps the primary tree shallow and surfaces the contextual actions. Also helps deep-linking without forcing the tree to expand in weird ways.

sam: Implementation Q: are we doing path-based deep links or hash anchors for the flyout? Hash makes it easy to not reload, path + history gives better semantics for copy/paste.

kevin: prefer path-based (pushState) so links are shareable and server-side fallbacks are simpler. But we need a canonicalization layer to avoid duplicates (trailing slash, legacy /models/:id vs /m/:id).

maya: Agreed on path-based. Proposed shape: `/console/:org/:space/:resourceType/:resourceId(/:subpage)(?query)`. Example: `/console/acme/prod/models/m-123/versions?v=2#metrics`

leah: Accessibility note — flyouts must be keyboard-focusable and not trap focus. Use `aria-expanded` on the parent, `aria-controls` to point to the flyout. Also ensure `aria-current` on the selected nav item.

sam: For keyboard nav: we should allow arrow keys to move between primary items, then Right Arrow opens flyout, Esc closes. Avoid duplicate Tab stops inside the tree.

kevin: Edge case: what happens when you deep-link to `/.../models/m-999/versions` and m-999 was deleted? Current behaviour: blank page + console error. We should redirect gracefully to `/console/:org/:space/models?notice=missing` with a toast and an accessible alert.

maya: Good call. Also: analytics — track `nav.section_open`, `nav.flyout_open`, `nav.deep_link_resolved` with resource type/id so we can measure broken links.

eva: Copy nit: in flyout header use "Context" over "Details" — clients interpret "Details" as editable fields. Small change but reduces confusion.

leah: Another a11y nit — ensure live region announces when a deep-link redirect happens (e.g., "Model not found, redirected to Models list"). Screen reader users need that extra affordance.

sam: Routing conflict thought — we have some legacy hash-based anchors in embeds and old docs. Plan: support both for 6 months. On hash arrival, translate to canonical path with `replaceState` so history isn't polluted.

kevin: Implementation sketch (backend + frontend):
```
1) Router maps canonical path -> UI state
2) On load, check resource exists (cache lookup). If missing -> redirect to parent list + `notice=gone`
3) On hash arrival, map -> push canonical path with replaceState
```

maya: UX question — when model has many subpages (metrics, logs, traces) do we show those as tabs inside the flyout or as shallow links in the flyout? I vote shallow links + badge counts so users know which have activity.

devin: Shallow links + badges. Also allow "open in main pane" action on right-arrow so power users can pin a subpage to center.

leah: Visual focus style: ensure 3px focus ring, high contrast, and not rely on color alone for selected state.

kevin: Dev note: watch for focus jumps when flyout mounts/animates — use `requestAnimationFrame` and `focus()` only after mount to avoid scroll jumps.

maya: I'll prototype the flyout (static mock) and map the canonical path shapes. Will post updated flows.

nav-bot: Deploy reminder — staging deploy for console-nav changes scheduled for 2026-04-04 02:00 UTC. Reaction :calendar:.

sam: OK — next steps: maya to share mock, kevin + sam rough router plan, leah accessibility checklist, devin finalize analytics dims. We'll reconvene after mock. :+1:
